description: Federal procurement search — opportunities + awards. Filtered search over the Ni Biashara procurement shelf: SAM.gov contract opportunities and USAspending contract awards as normalized, joined records with structured deadlines. Filter by text, agency, NAICS, set-aside, record type, deadline window or value floor. $0.25 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.

agency.description: agency name text, e.g. Department of Veterans Affairs (optional)

closing_within_days.description: only records with a deadline within this many days (optional)

limit.description: max records to return (optional, default 25, max 60)

min_value_usd.description: only records valued at or above this many USD (optional)

q.description: free text over title, agency, description, recipient and solicitation id (optional)

name: search_procurement
title: Federal procurement search — opportunities + awards
